messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync — CobaltGrid weekly health snapshot. TL;DR: token consumption down ~18% WoW, QoQ -5%; avg gen latency up ~120ms (280 -> 400ms) for chat endpoints; error rate jumped to 2.1% after Tue deploy (baseline ~0.4%); spend +12% MoM due to avg sequence length increase. Onboarding note: cohort 2 finished initial enablement, next workshop Thu 10am PT. Renewal risk: low but monitor spikes in spend. Need eng help to validate routing and KV cache behavior. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/cobaltgrid/token-sparkline :eyes:

sam_engineer: Thanks — digging in. Which model variants are they hitting mostly? small/medium/large?

maria_cs: They mostly use rwd-chat-medium for production routes, fallbacks to rwd-chat-small in bursts. Recent increase in long sequences appears tied to a new feature they shipped (user transcripts appended).

aj_ops: Noted. Error spikes coincide with sustained bursts at 100–150 concurrent sessions around Tue 14:00 UTC. We saw a cascade of model switches in the routing logs.

sam_engineer: Can you paste the routing log snippet from Tue 14:00? Also any request IDs?

maria_cs: Pasting minimal log snippet: ```
2025-11-12T14:01:03Z route=prod-cobalt model=rwd-chat-medium latency=405ms status=200 req_id=req_8a1b
2025-11-12T14:01:04Z route=prod-cobalt model=rwd-chat-medium latency=410ms status=200 req_id=req_8a2c
2025-11-12T14:02:10Z route=prod-cobalt model=rwd-chat-small latency=980ms status=504 req_id=req_8f9d fallback=enabled
2025-11-12T14:02:11Z route=prod-cobalt model=rwd-chat-small latency=1200ms status=504 req_id=req_8fa0
```

jordan_pm: 504s look like capacity/timeout on small fallback. Could be that fallback can't sustain the longer seqs. If small times out, requests bubble up as errors.

sam_engineer: Agreed. My hypothesis: KV cache eviction + quantized kernel path mismatch for long sequences on the small variant -> thrashes memory and causes tail latency to explode. I'll add a quick probe job to reproduce with a 3k token transcript.

infra-bot: Probe job queued: job-id=probe-176501-42 owner=sam_engineer. ETA ~12m. Will post results. :robot_face:

aj_ops: For enablement, recommend we add a short doc for CobaltGrid: "Best practices for transcript-heavy workloads" — call out batch size, max seq, and recommended model pin for long-context requests. I can draft.

maria_cs: Please do. Also ask billing to hold on automated renewal nudges until we confirm spend stabilization — don't want to alarm them. Action items: 1) Sam: run probe + share traces (req_ids) — due today. 2) Aj: draft enablement doc + workshop slide update — due Wed EOD. 3) CS: hold renewal automation until green.

sam_engineer: On it. Will paste trace links here when probe completes. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Probe job completed. result=partial-repro status=high-tail-latency trace_link=https://redwood.internal/traces/probe-176501-42

sam_engineer: Partial repro confirmed — tail latency >1s for sequences >2.2k on rwd-chat-small. Attached trace IDs: req_8f9d, req_8fa0, probe-176501-42. Next step: suggest routing policy change to prefer medium for seq>1k and increase fallback timeout.

aj_ops: Drafting doc now. Will ping design for a 1-slide explainer for Thu workshop.

maria_cs: Great. I'll update CobaltGrid customer thread and propose a short change window to tweak routing rules this Fri 03:00 UTC for a 1-hour test. Anyone opposed?

jordan_pm: Fine by me — just ensure rollback plan documented.

sam_engineer: OK. I'll prepare rollout + rollback runbook.

maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll follow up after Friday test with a consolidated pulse (tokens, latency, errors, spend) and recommended next steps. :white_check_mark:
